benefits: - To spread information about aromatic plants and the benefits of their cultivation to the general public. - To provide information about crops according to the agricultural climate.
detailed_description: The “Aromatic Awareness Programme” is implemented by the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun, under the Department of Horticulture, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to raise awareness about aromatic plants and their benefits, and to provide guidance on cultivation practices suitable to different agricultural climates.
eligibility: 1. Any interested individual who is a resident of Uttarakhand can avail the benefits of the programme.
